title: Velo Minty Lemon Slim Nicotine Pouches - Original (10mg)
description: Velo Slim Minty Lemon Nicotine Pouches combine the sharp citrus taste of Lemon with a fresh Peppermint note, producing a flavour that tastes bright, cool and invigorating. The mix of tart citrus and mint freshness gives Minty Lemon a distinctive character. Each can contains 20 slim pouches made from plant-based fibres, designed for a discreet and comfortable fit under the lip. Nicotine is released gradually without smoke, vapour or odour, offering a clean and practical alternative for adult users. Produced in Europe, Velo nicotine pouches are available in a wide range of flavours and strengths. Minty Lemon is available here in a Medium 10mg strength, delivering a more potent release than lighter options in the range. Nicotine Ranges: Mellow - 4mg to 6mg this is best for new users. Original - 6mg to 11mg this is best for regular users. Intense - 8mg to 17mg this is suited for more experienced users How to Use: Place one pouch under your upper lip and leave it in place for 20–40 minutes while the flavour and nicotine release gradually. When finished, remove the pouch and dispose of it responsibly. Please Note: Do not chew, suck or swallow the pouches.
